cmd: uv run python .claude/work-queue/scripts/generate-index.py || true && git status --short | sed -n '1,120p'

for d in /mnt/local-analysis/workspace-hub/*; do [ -d "$d" ] || continue; [ -f "$d/.codex/config.toml" ] && echo "$d/.codex/config.toml"; done; [ -f /mnt/local-analysis/workspace-hub/.codex/config.toml ] && echo /mnt/local-analysis/workspace-hub/.codex/config.toml

jq -r '.sync_items.git_repositories.base_path as $b | .sync_items.git_repositories.repos[] | "\($b)/\(.)/.codex/config.toml"' config/sync-items.json | while read -r f; do [ -f "$f" ] && echo "$f"; done
command -v jq >/dev/null && echo jq_ok || echo jq_missing
for d in /mnt/local-analysis/workspace-hub/*; do [ -d "$d" ] || continue; [ -d "$d/.git" ] || continue; if [ -f "$d/.codex/config.toml" ]; then echo "$d/.codex/config.toml"; fi; done
uv run python /mnt/local-analysis/workspace-hub/.claude/work-queue/scripts/generate-index.py || true && git status --short | sed -n '1,140p'

for f in scripts/agents/session.sh scripts/agents/work.sh scripts/agents/plan.sh scripts/agents/execute.sh scripts/agents/review.sh scripts/work-queue/claim-item.sh scripts/work-queue/close-item.sh; do echo "FILE $f"; sed -n '1,220p' "$f"; done

printf '%s
' 'Using skill: code-reviewer, because this is a plan review and I need repo-grounded findings.'

rg -n '^## Plan|^# Plan|^## Investigation Questions|^## Risks|^## Testing|^## Dependencies|^## Scope' .claude/work-queue/pending/WRK-1017.md
rg -n "^## Plan|^# Plan|^## Review Questions|^## Risks|^## Testing|^## Phases" .claude/work-queue/pending/WRK-1017.md
for f in scripts/session/tests/fixtures/*.jsonl; do echo "FILE:$f"; sed -n '1,120p' "$f"; done

print(1)' scripts/session/tests/fixtures/session-with-violations.jsonl

' '{"event":"tool_use","cmd":"echo uv run && python3 scripts/foo.py"}' > "$tmp1"
UV_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/uv-cache bash scripts/session/detect-drift.sh --log "$tmp1" --no-git
rm -f "$tmp1"

' '{"event":"tool_use","cmd":"git commit -m '\''feat(session): add drift detection'\''"}' > "$tmp2"
